gmail.title: Gmail token
gmail.desc: Used to send email via your Gmail account. You can select this token in Gmail nodes.
gmail.accessTokenPlaceholder: Paste your Gmail access token here
gmail.refreshTokenPlaceholder: Add if you have a refresh token
gmail.howToTitle: Where do I get a token?
gmail.howToSteps: Create an OAuth 2.0 client in Google Cloud Console and obtain access and refresh tokens, then paste them above. If you're not technical, ask your admin to issue tokens for you.

meta.title: Meta (Facebook) token
meta.desc: Used for Meta services like Facebook and Instagram ads. Select this token when using Meta API in your flow.
meta.accessTokenPlaceholder: Paste your Meta access token here
meta.refreshTokenPlaceholder: Add if you have a refresh token
meta.howToTitle: Where do I get a token?
meta.howToSteps: Create an app in Meta for Developers, set up permissions (e.g. Marketing API), then get an access token and paste it above. Ask your marketing or dev team if you need help.
